# Noxptide

> Noxptide is a UK supplier of ≥99% purity research peptides for laboratories and researchers. Every batch is independently verified by HPLC and mass spectrometry, and every vial ships with a batch-specific Certificate of Analysis (COA). All products are for in-vitro laboratory research use only — not for human or veterinary use. Free UK delivery over £25; same-day dispatch on orders before 4pm Monday–Friday; volume pricing 20% off over £150 and 30% off over £500; 7-day money-back guarantee; price match promise.

## Shop

- [Peptides](https://noxptide.co.uk/shop): The complete catalogue — all 32 research peptides under one heading, with CAS numbers, sequences and pricing in GBP.
- [Research Guides](https://noxptide.co.uk/guides): In-depth laboratory guides, comparisons and handling protocols.
